title: Goal
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a high-level qualitative statement of intent or direction for the organization. Goals are derived from Drivers and refined into measurable Objectives. Rootless — a Goal is a strategic classification, not an active system. TOGAF mapping: Goal (Motivation Extension, Architecture Vision). Source framework: TOGAF (Motivation Extension, Architecture Vision).

scope.description: Goal scope within the organization. ENTERPRISE = organization-wide. BUSINESS_UNIT = specific unit. DOMAIN = architecture domain. PROJECT = project-specific. TOGAF mapping: Goal scope in Architecture Vision.

timeHorizon.description: Strategic time horizon for the goal. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Vision time horizon.
